answer_1.quote: In this paper, we address an open-domain setting where one cannot rely on an immediate grounding of the meaning of questions in the target domain... Our key contribution is a lightweight method to ground question-asking model from image captioning data...
answer_1.outputs: polar questions and 'what' questions in visually grounded dialog

answer_2.quote: We evaluated our question-asking framework in grounded interactions with both synthetic and human answerers... We evaluate these models on a total of 1,000 games sampled from each dataset using contexts of size k = 10 images.

answer_4.quote: We recruited a total of 40 participants from Amazon Mechanical Turk to play 10 games each in which our model asked questions until the entropy of the belief distribution over images fell below 1.0 or until 20 questions were asked.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were prompted to give either a "yes", "no", or "N/A" response to each question.
